title: Microsoft.Entra/groupLifecyclePolicies
description: The tenant's Microsoft 365 group expiration policy (groupLifecyclePolicy). Graph allows one per tenant, so the resource name is always default; the policy is found by listing the collection. With managedGroupTypes Selected, groups join it through their groupLifecyclePolicies edge. Delete switches group expiration off. Needs Microsoft Entra ID P1 or P2 licences for the members of the governed groups.

groupLifetimeInDays.description: Required on create: days until a group expires and must be renewed (Microsoft Entra offers 180, 365 or a custom value of 30 days or more).

managedGroupTypes.description: Required on create: All (every Microsoft 365 group), Selected (only the groups added to the policy) or None.

alternateNotificationEmails.description: Addresses notified about groups without owners, separated by semicolons; compared as a case-insensitive set.

permissions.notes: Learn (grouplifecyclepolicy-post-grouplifecyclepolicies, -update, -delete, -addgroup, -removegroup): Directory.ReadWrite.All is the least privileged write permission (delegated and application); reads need Directory.Read.All. Learn (entra groups-lifecycle): Groups Administrator or User Administrator manage the policy. Expiration needs Microsoft Entra ID P1 (or higher) licences for the members of the groups it governs.
